intent: Replace the Mission Control A2A adapter's latest-wins external-task lookup with the admitted bounded exact-list seam. A new dispatch may observe zero identities only before it records its typed canonical identity; status recovery and the final broker-publish gate require exactly one matching durable identity. Duplicate identities fail closed independent of insertion order or metadata freshness and produce no additional transport publish.

negative_controls.name: one-row-truncation-cannot-hide-duplicate-identity
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys; p=Path('dharma_swarm/mission_control_a2a.py'); t=p.read_text(); old='limit=2,'; assert t.count(old) == 1; p.write_text(t.replace(old, 'limit=1,', 1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', 'tests/test_mission_control_a2a.py', '-k', 'duplicate_external_identity_is_rejected_before_publish_regardless_of_insertion_order'], check=False).returncode)"

commit.message: fix(a2a): require exact external task identity

interface_mismatches: The legacy singular RuntimeState lookup orders by mutable updated_at and run_id then returns one row, so a valid-looking latest row can hide a second durable identity for the same external task identifier.
The separately admitted RuntimeState exact-list seam is the only bounded ambiguity oracle for this slice; this adapter must consume it without editing or duplicating RuntimeState ownership.

Zero identities is valid only at the typed new-dispatch branch before the adapter records its canonical identity; recovery, observation, and the final transport-publish gate require exactly one identity equal to the stable run binding.
A broker acknowledgement proves transport acceptance only; exact identity does not prove handler contact, semantic outcome, verified completion, executor liveness, or global uniqueness.
honest_blockers: The exact-list RuntimeState method is owned and sealed by the separate supervisor packet; this packet verifies its focused integration call but does not independently certify or alter that implementation.

The bounded two-row lookup proves zero, one, or more-than-one rows at the instant of its read; it is not a database uniqueness constraint and cannot exclude a hostile concurrent writer inserting a duplicate after the final check.
Repository tests use a local fake broker and local SQLite state; they do not prove a deployed NATS route, handler liveness, semantic quality, or external completion.
No publish side effect means no call to the injected broker transport; durable identity rows inserted as adversarial test setup remain runtime owner state, not transport work.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the A2A adapter exact-one lookup, its adversarial tests, and this packet as one unit. Rollback changes no RuntimeState schema or supervisor code, but it restores unsafe latest-wins ambiguity behavior and therefore must not be used while duplicate external identifiers are possible.
